purpose: Bounded independent impasse audit, not a new generic search pass.
shipment: Direct Japan personal postal purchase of100g sealed manufactured steamed/dried Camellia sinensis sencha. No permits, origin certificates, special registration, separate approval or advance notice; ordinary customs/post declarations and ordinary arrival inspection are allowed.

interpretationCheck.principle: An applicable exhaustive schedule, general processing rule or automatic personal/postal exemption can settle a country. The audit does not require a tea-specific permission merely because one has not been published.
interpretationCheck.testedFrenchCrossScheduleInference: The1990 order includes a Réunion-specific dried-tea condition and separately exempts certain small noncommercial postal goods in Article14. Those provisions were checked as possible general-rule routes. They do not extend the Réunion-specific condition to other territories, establish a universal heat-processing classification, or displace later local personal-import prohibitions. The already-reviewed national list-based conclusion remains valid.
interpretationCheck.newPrimaryRetrieval: No new operative source recovered. A targeted Légifrance recheck of the existing1990 provision used its indexed official text after the general consolidated URL was inaccessible. This did not change the evidence outcome.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The authorized PCEC guide expressly exempts e-commerce post. The WTO description of plant-product authorizations does not define the covered manufactured products, so neither a conformity exclusion nor a plant-health approval follows.
records.missingExternalEvidence: An operative Congo plant-health product definition/category or applicable commodity condition covering or excluding finished steamed/dried tea; its personal-post application.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The current official report confirms the 2006 proclamation. Manufactured-product coverage is conditional on pest risk; packaging and manufacture alone do not establish the statutory exception. Arrival quality inspection is not an extra origin-document duty.
records.missingExternalEvidence: A published national processing/risk-category rule, commodity condition or applicable personal-food provision. The 2026 food-policy workshop is drafting activity, not an operative rule.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The 2026 plant proclamation replaces the old starting point and retains a processed-product risk issue. The 2014 food directive expressly exempts personal food from competence licensing, while its company scope and separate shipment-document clause prevent either a private certificate requirement or waiver being inferred.
records.missingExternalEvidence: An applicable processed-product category under Proclamation1400/2026 and current EFDA personal-food scope. Old commercial FAIRS guidance cannot fill either gap.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The newly recovered signed 2024 order includes final-consumer use but has a transport limitation and an exception for non-sale/noncommercial articles. It therefore does not establish an unavoidable certificate duty for private air post. The existing plant-law risk limitation is separate.
records.missingExternalEvidence: Current implementation resolving Articles3–5 of OrderA/2024/920 for paid private post, plus a national processing/risk classification or exemption. A company-only platform manual supplies neither.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: Current official/NPPO and postal material does not disclose the operative finished-food plant-health coverage. Absence of a retrieved prohibition cannot prove permission.
records.missingExternalEvidence: An applicable current national plant-product/food-import rule or schedule covering this commodity and personal postal route.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The plant law includes unprocessed or simply prepared products but does not specify how factory steaming/drying is treated. The food-control decree delegates documentary duties to implementing regulation. Those enabling clauses are not a certificate requirement.
records.missingExternalEvidence: An operative processing/category definition or applicable implementing food-import condition. No such current rule is identified in the examined public trail.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: Personal food is within the food law, but the examined certificate duties concern particular animal products and import businesses. The plant law makes manufactured coverage risk-dependent, and the foreign-trade law delegates technical-control lists.
records.missingExternalEvidence: The adopted technical-control list/method or national risk/processing rule relevant to tea. Previously found blank-number/date drafts do not establish adoption.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: Enacted DM98/2023 Article4 expressly exempts postal parcels from PAC. It does not amend the independent plant law, whose manufactured-product scope is risk-dependent. Propagation conditions and empty portal results do not settle food tea.
records.missingExternalEvidence: An operative plant-health processing category, personal-post exception or consumption commodity condition for Japan-origin finished tea.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The1976 Notice expressly covers dried material but contains a potentially relevant cooked-material exception and an ambiguous bottle/can qualification. Neither steaming-as-cooking nor automatic coverage can safely be assumed. The available food Bill is not the authenticated final2018 Act.
records.missingExternalEvidence: An applicable published interpretation/category resolving the Notice exception for manufactured steamed tea, or the authenticated final food statute with an independently decisive private-import duty.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.missingExternalEvidence: The delegated plant commodity-document conditions, or operative application/exemption of the annual declaration order to private postal purchases.

records.generalRuleAssessment: Destination inspection under regulation7 is a real alternative to pre-export CoC. Regulation8 uses a customs declaration and makes an exemption letter conditional; the low-value letter route cannot be treated as the only lawful route. Independently the plant law leaves manufactured-product risk unresolved.
records.missingExternalEvidence: Published private-post operation of regulation7/8 or a full readable operative text settling that route, plus a plant-health processing/risk classification. Prior official PDF403 attempts are already exhausted.
records.whyNoAdditionalActionNow: The recorded targeted source routes and peer reviews reveal no new specific operative-source location. Repeating generic legislation searches or previously failed URLs would not change the identified legal/evidentiary gap.

records.generalRuleAssessment: The2026 Environment Code living-specimen rule excludes nonliving finished tea from that restriction. The2007 continuity law plus Code rural supplies the national-law chain; national certificate-list absence is already a valid conclusion. The same continuity can preserve the separate local restriction.
records.missingExternalEvidence: Actual Order96-323 of16April1996 and its territorial/channel scope or a current instrument replacing it. An individual tea ruling is not inherently needed.

records.missingExternalEvidence: A binding/general processing interpretation determining whether steamed/dried manufacture is beyond simple preparation; ideally the original official local order rather than the corroborated reproduction currently available.

limitation: This is a finding that the presently identified public evidence and source routes do not finish these countries, not proof that the rules do not exist or that tea is prohibited. A refined gap is not a completed country.
